summary: Implemented the approved quick spec by adding idempotent Supabase runtime backfill for active enrollments, populating runtime measurements/checkpoints via insert-missing semantics, exposing backfill counters in sync outputs/startup logging, and adding regression unit coverage. Mentor endpoint regression suite passed; radar API suite has pre-existing 409-based failures in setup flow.
decisions: Kept route/API contracts unchanged and scoped all logic to operations/repositories.
Added non-destructive insert-missing methods in Postgres indicator repositories while preserving existing replace_for_enrollment behavior for admin load flows.
Targeted only active enrollments during backfill orchestration to satisfy runtime coverage requirement.
Exposed operational observability through runtime_backfill counters in sync report/result and startup logs.
risks: Startup backfill depends on runtime table write permissions and successful unique-index creation.
Current implementation performs per-enrollment insert calls; correctness is prioritized over batch performance.
Radar API test file currently fails in its own setup path (409 vs expected 200) and remains outside this patch scope.
